name: frozen-crow
description: Frozen Crow team skills and plugins for Claude

plugins.name: dev-standards
plugins.description: Frozen Crow developer standards: monogit for all git work across repos, agent-vault for every credential.

plugins.name: api-standards
plugins.description: Frozen Crow API standards: build every API on @frozencrow/api-core (Feathers 5, Koa, MongoDB) and add resources through its generators so auth, RBAC and tenant isolation come for free.

plugins.name: frontend-standards
plugins.description: Frozen Crow frontend standards: Nuxt or Next for SEO-driven marketing sites, Vue or React SPAs for app clients decoupled from the API, shared layouts and components built with Tailwind and Headless UI, and a Feathers client for api-core APIs.

plugins.name: wordpress-standards
plugins.description: Frozen Crow WordPress standards: build and edit WordPress sites through WP MCP Connector; work directly on production for an initial build, and use a staging clone for large changes to a live site.

plugins.name: orchestration-standards
plugins.description: Frozen Crow orchestration standards: run multi-agent work through Orca with one worktree and one agent per piece of the product, a supervising coordinator, and a one-question preference check before anything starts.
